title: GG ATHLETIC™ Everyday Tee
_source: Title, sizes, prices and care copy from Shopify draft 10249996501184 (read 2026-10-28). Garment line and print-location line corrected to match the blank and the front-only artwork.
description_html:
FAITH IN MOTION.™

GG ATHLETIC™ is clean, premium GOD GEAR™ built to move — everyday apparel carrying the FAITH IN MOTION.™ identity.

GOD IS MY SOURCE!

Details

  • Unisex jersey tee (Bella+Canvas 3001), Black
  • GOD GEAR™ wordmark on the front
  • Made to order

Fabric, weight and size measurements are published once the garment passes GOD GEAR™ sample certification. See the Size guide.

Care

  • Machine wash cold, inside out
  • Tumble dry low or hang dry
  • Do not iron directly on the print
  • Do not dry clean
_allowed_models_note: Founder-approved evidence: Founder Option A 2026-10-24 + PF-W2 work order 1pPkL5c7dLszdVutx56IyOW8WovSmvefZQ60wfUHoQzY (rebuild GG ATHLETIC on Bella+Canvas 3001); PY-02 1W-CLGvM_CNVn7VWO84C2jRv9JTpyBHGGLGPm7VNU3zU row 1 (3001, GO); concept sheet 2026-10-20 (3001). Open objection: CRITIC Cycle 3 ruling 2026-10-25 (1km6hLDIF8q7bXGUvKF5z6OUVDG4SrjewDnDfOWCnv90) removed 3001 as default and opened a heavyweight qualification; no Founder decision adopting it was found and no heavyweight was qualified. Comfort Colors 1717 is NOT allowed (it is GG ACTIVE's blank; no approval to reuse it here). BMW canon: no sale before physical sample certification regardless of blank.
_back_art_note: Front-only. The approved G mark (GG_G_MARK_PRINTFUL_EXACT.png) is in Printful's file library only, with no YFE-hosted URL; it is added here when one exists.
